note: After a real search, no public queryable parcel polygon service found for Haskell County KS. County appraiser site links no GIS service (only ecountyworks tax search). State ORKA parcel access is via a per-county PORKA request; the statewide KS_ORKA_Extras MapServer has only subdivision/lot/ag-use/address layers, no tax parcels. Commercial vendors (Dynamo, Equator, Rockford, Regrid) sell parcel files; these are not county publications.
